tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 5 scoreboard is already doing things. Ryan is putting up 32.8 on Wingard right now and AEGIS needs every point of it. SDR at $56.11 — down 13.7% — and the gap between those two prices tells you everything about the stakes on that side of the field.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Corbishley at zero against Jake's 23.5 early is not panic territory yet, but APEX is the number-two team in the league and they do not get spotted three scores at home. I called Apex as a real championship contender before the season and I am not walking that back over a first-quarter deficit.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I am 8-4 with a 2-0 lock record and I need a proper segment to discuss why the pick-em board keeps getting framed as a horse race when the process gap at the top is already significant. Terrence is at 5-7. That is not a slump. That is a methodology problem.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Terrence the schedule did not go 5-7. You went 5-7. There is a difference and the standings board does not accept explanations, only outcomes.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Yeah I saw the 5-7 discourse and I will say this: the schedule has been cruel, my reads have been right more than the record shows, and a 6-6 correction is coming before anyone can dunk on me again.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, ForgeHammer is up 31-11 on Drew in Havana's favorite road game right now and FORG is also the only team on the exchange that moved plus-12.8% this issue to $88.66. Fronge relocated to Cuba, has zero pick liquidity, and is somehow the feel-good story of Week 5. I have no framework for this.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Kevin versus Brent is the game nobody is watching and it is exactly the one that matters. RDC at $95.35 — up 15.1% — against OBS at $75.90, and ksanda is sitting at 5-3 quietly lining up a playoff push while Brent's TE monopoly posts zeroes in the win column. I have Brent picked and I already regret it.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Charles versus Mitchum is 0.0 to 1.9 and the Ledger is going to have something very important to say about what happens when an 8-0 juggernaut meets the team that just dropped 187 points on a 5-3 opponent. Those two prices — CROWN at $148.52 and DEEP at $87.66 — are not playing the same game.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Power rankings are unavailable this cycle and I want everyone to sit with that information before they decide to spend the afternoon writing think-pieces about where I have Mitchum slotted. You do not know where I have Mitchum slotted. None of you know anything.
